sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the  following:
 ORDER

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.47/2023 registered at Police Station-Kamla Nagar,
Bhopal District-Bhopal (MP) for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(3), 328, 342 of IPC & 3/4 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that prosecutrix is examined in Court and she is hostile.
Applicant is young boy of 18 years and he is in jail since 26.10.2023.
In these circumstances, he prayed that applicant may be released on bail.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted that offence is serious in nature and POCSO Act is also attracted in the case.
In these circumstances, bail application deserves to be dismissed.
4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5 . Considering the fact that prosecutrix is hostile before the Court and applicant is young boy of 18 years, bail application stands allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on aforesaid conditions on furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only)
with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE nd Aniket Tamoli @ Bheda vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140603157/
